market_outlook.short_term: Markets likely choppy 1-3 months as Fed hike digestion continues. Oil volatility from Iran war and Saudi pipeline repairs creates whipsaw. Tech/AI names lead on chip rotation. Freight and auto loan sectors under pressure. Expect 3-5% equity volatility range.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if inflation stabilizes post-hike. AI capex cycle and China copper demand support growth. However, global optimism decline and geopolitical risks cap upside. Historical pattern (decades-long) suggests eventual correction within 12 months. Favor quality, cash-generative names over speculative growth.
